description:
Check if a skill is compatible with a specific platform before downloading. / 다운로드 전 호환성 검증.
    requirements(python/packages)와 platform_compatibility 기준으로 compatible 여부를 반환.

    Args:
        skill_id: 검증할 스킬 ID
        python_version: 에이전트 Python 버전 (예: "3.11.2")
        os: "linux" | "darwin" | "windows"
        installed_packages: {"requests": "2.31.0"} 형태 dict (선택)
        target_platform: 설치 대상 플랫폼 ("ClaudeCode" 등)

    Returns:
        요약 문자열 (compatible 여부 + 누락 패키지 + 추천 설치 명령)

installed_packages.description: Installed Python packages as an object mapping package name to version, e.g. {"requests": "2.31.0"}. Optional.
installed_packages.title: Installed Packages

os.description: Operating system of the agent environment, one of: linux | darwin | windows. Empty skips the OS check.
os.title: Os

python_version.description: Python version of the agent environment, e.g. '3.11.2'. Empty skips the Python check.
python_version.title: Python Version

skill_id.description: Skill UUID as returned by search_skills in the [...] prefix of each result, e.g. 4bda3fb4-8d5c-4387-bd9f-47d75570b56a.
skill_id.title: Skill Id

target_platform.description: Platform the skill will be installed on, one of: OpenClaw | ClaudeCode | ClaudeCodeAgentSkill | CodexCLI | Cursor | GeminiCLI | CustomAgent. Empty skips the platform check.
target_platform.title: Target Platform

name: validate_compatibility
